titleEn: Evaluate the Bracket Pairs of a String
title: 替换字符串中的括号内容
summary: 把字符串每个 (key) 替换为 knowledge 中对应 value，不存在则替换为问号。
insight: 把 knowledge 建成哈希表，扫描字符串；普通字符直接追加，左括号则找到右括号并查表追加替换值。
pitfalls: 未知键替换为单个问号

solutions.title: 扫描括号并哈希替换
solutions.idea: 按语法边界逐段构造结果。
steps: position 扫描；非左括号直接追加
左括号时找 next )，提取 key，追加 map.getOrDefault(key,"?") 并跳到右括号后

code.java: class Solution { public String evaluate(String text,List<List<String>> knowledge){Map<String,String> map=new HashMap<>();for(List<String> pair:knowledge)map.put(pair.get(0),pair.get(1));StringBuilder answer=new StringBuilder();for(int i=0;i<text.length();){if(text.charAt(i)!='(')answer.append(text.charAt(i++));else{int end=text.indexOf(')',i);answer.append(map.getOrDefault(text.substring(i+1,end),"?"));i=end+1;}}return answer.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun evaluate(text:String,knowledge:List<List<String>>):String{val map=knowledge.associate{it[0] to it[1]};val answer=StringBuilder();var position=0;while(position<text.length)if(text[position]!='(')answer.append(text[position++]) else{val end=text.indexOf(')',position);answer.append(map[text.substring(position+1,end)]?:"?");position=end+1};return answer.toString()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: string evaluate(string text,vector<vector<string>>& knowledge){unordered_map<string,string> map;for(auto& pair:knowledge)map[pair[0]]=pair[1];string answer;for(int i=0;i<(int)text.size();)if(text[i]!='(')answer+=text[i++];else{int end=text.find(')',i);string key=text.substr(i+1,end-i-1);answer+=map.count(key)?map[key]:"?";i=end+1;}return answer;} };
